messages:
Noah (PM): dropping frames for a new first-run surface: sample gallery (grid of cards) vs compact launch chip. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyZA1234/first-run-samples
Noah (PM): goal: increase sample starts without annoying repeat users. want copy variants, a11y check, and quick qual plan.

Asha (Design): gallery shows intent thumbnails + short purpose lines, good for discovery. chip is subtle and can expand to a tray. gallery = higher visual cost.

Diego (Frontend): gallery needs lazy loads and keyboardable cards; chip needs expand/contract animation and persisted per-workspace state. both need clear DOM order for keyboard flow.

June (A11y): quick accessibility notes:
- small caption text on cards fails contrast in dark mode; use semantic tokens
- ensure each card has descriptive aria-label (title + purpose + "~5 minutes")
- tray expand must use aria-expanded and announce content via aria-live=polite
- when tray/dialog opens, focus should move to the panel and return on close
- close buttons: visible label for screen readers (avoid only icons)

Clara (DevEx): analytics/events: sample_surface_shown (gallery|chip), sample_opened, sample_skipped, sample_dismissed_reason. add experiment_id and cohort. gate display on telemetry_consent true.

Ravi (Research): suggestion: run 10 quick moderated sessions in the canary cohort and an intercept survey on dismiss asking "Why didn't you try a sample?". also test microcopy with time estimate e.g., "About 5 minutes".

onboard-bot: reminder  run axe smoke and keyboard nav locally before merging.

Asha (Design): copy sets to test (tone + CTAs):
1) Warm: "Try a sample project" CTA: "Open sample" secondary: "Maybe later"
2) Crisp: "Start with a sample" CTA: "Use sample" secondary: "Skip"
3) Minimal: "Try demo" CTA: "Launch" secondary: "Close"
I prefer Warm for first exposure.

June (A11y): also recommend adding SR-only text for time estimate: "Approximately five minutes to complete" and not relying on color to convey urgency or status.

Diego (Frontend): CSS sketch for chip tray:
```css
.sample-chip { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 60; }
.sample-tray[aria-expanded="true"] { transform: translateY(0); }
```
I'll ensure close button receives focus first when tabbing.

Clara (DevEx): feature-flag plan: key = samples_firstrun_variant; internal 100% uses chip; external A/B: 25% gallery, 25% chip, rest control. metric gates: sample_start uplift and dismiss rate < 10%.

Noah (PM): action items: Asha update frames with warm copy + contrast tokens; June review tokens + SR text; Diego draft PR (DOM order + focus); Clara add events + flag; Ravi schedule 10 sessions. target: Wed EOD for updated frames and draft PRs. :thumbsup:

Asha (Design): on it  will post updated prototypes tomorrow with mobile stacking and alt copy for thumbnails.

Diego (Frontend): will open draft PR early Tue, including lazy-loading skeletons for gallery.

June (A11y): will run NVDA/VoiceOver quick checks once PR is up and post notes.

Ravi (Research): will prep a short intercept and script for moderated sessions.

onboard-bot: checklist added to PR template: a11y, analytics, feature-flag, and research signoff.

Noah (PM): great work. we'll measure lift and qualitative feedback before wider rollout. ping here for blockers.
